faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits a wide range of Acer Aspire models that share the same keyboard, including the ES1-511, E5-411, E5-471, E1-470, E1-432, V3-472, E1-422, 3830, 4830, 4755, E1-472, E1-410, ES1-411, E1-430, E5-421, ES1-421, ES1-431, V3-431 and V3-471. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this is the non-backlit version.
